note: Named action GIFs (NOT PetState). Filenames must not collide with lifecycle/docked reserved names. Runtime loads them into LoadedImageSkin.actions. FRAMES=3..8 (default 4): 00=poseA, 01..N-2=pose/prop (animBeat + optional animBeats[]), last=blink. Mid frames must not be blink-only.
